sections.name: HealthCardSkeleton
sections.title: Placeholder shaped like a health card
sections.what: Builds a loading placeholder that copies the layout of a health card, with short, medium and large blocks.
sections.why: Likely reason: matches the real card layout so the page does not jump when data loads.
sections.watch_out: The shape is fixed, so it may not match a card with different content.

summary: Grey pulsing placeholder blocks shown while content loads, plus a ready-made placeholder shaped like a health card.
purpose: Shows the page layout before the data arrives, so the screen is not blank.
why: Header says fluid loading patterns. Likely reason: avoid blank screens while loading.
how: The base block is a grey rectangle that pulses, with rounded corners. The health card placeholder is built from several of these blocks arranged in a card shape.
inputs: Optional class names and the usual div props.
risks: The placeholder shape is fixed, so it can differ from the real content. Nothing here decides when to show or hide it; the calling page must do that.
debug: If placeholders stay on screen, check the loading state in the page that shows them.
